Land geometry: Natural Earth 4.1.0, 1:110m, distributed as TopoJSON by
world-atlas 2.0.2. Natural Earth data are public domain.

Downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/land-110m.json
Project: https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas
Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

The map represents indicator coverage. U.S. and Irish markers are approximate
national label positions, not physical facilities. Global copper prices do not
receive a country-specific marker.
